title: Wringer untracked-file digests
description: `untracked.json` — a sha256 for every UNTRACKED file in the working tree when the gates ran. A SIBLING of manifest.json, like digests.json and for the same reason: `wringer.evidence.v1` is frozen, so the tree's untracked bytes arrive as their own file rather than as a manifest key, and a reader that does not know this file ignores it. It exists because git cannot diff a file it has never seen: `diff.patch` is silent about untracked content, so without this a content-only edit to a new file between `wring verify` and `wring deliver` was undetectable — the last hole in delivery's promise that the tree it ships is the tree the gates ran against. Untracked is not ignored: anything in .gitignore never appears here, so the cost is bounded by what `git status` already reports. Absent from a bundle whose tree had nothing untracked — an empty file would be a claim about a state that never existed.

algorithm.description: The digest algorithm. Named rather than assumed, so a future change is a value rather than a silent reinterpretation of every existing file.

files.description: Repo-relative POSIX path -> hex digest, or the literal "unreadable" for a file whose bytes could not be read. `unreadable` is recorded rather than skipped, and `wring deliver` refuses on it: a file nobody could read is a file nobody verified, and silence would be the friendlier lie.
